subject.title: fix(cron): stop stalled fallback setup across all execution phases

question: After direct fallback-runtime proof is supplied, should this availability-sensitive cron watchdog behavior be accepted for merge on the current head?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, and the changed timeout governs whether a scheduled execution is stopped after falling back into setup.

options.title: Merge after runtime proof
options.body: Accept the canonical-map repair once a redacted live fallback timeout trace proves the affected user path and the branch is refreshed against current main.

options.title: Retain the existing behavior
options.body: Decline the broader rearm policy if maintainers do not want every execution-to-setup transition to receive the short setup watchdog.

recommendation.title: Merge after runtime proof
recommendation.body: Accept the canonical-map repair once a redacted live fallback timeout trace proves the affected user path and the branch is refreshed against current main.
